description: Generated logic-grid puzzle (5 houses, 8 clues, unique solution verified by brute force).

input.message:
There are 5 houses in a row, numbered 1 to 5 from left to right. Each house has a different colour (red, green, blue, amber, violet) and exactly one resident (Ada, Bruno, Chen, Dara, Eli).

Clues:
1. Dara lives in the red house.
2. Chen lives in house number 3 (houses are numbered 1 to 5 from left to right).
3. Dara lives somewhere to the right of Eli.
4. Bruno lives in the green house.
5. The violet house is directly next to the amber house.
6. Bruno lives in house number 5 (houses are numbered 1 to 5 from left to right).
7. Ada lives in house number 2 (houses are numbered 1 to 5 from left to right).
8. Chen lives in the violet house.

Determine, for every house number, who lives there and what colour it is. This puzzle has exactly one solution.

End your answer with one line per house in EXACTLY this format:
House 1: <name> - <colour>
House 2: <name> - <colour>
(and so on)
